meta.name: mllm-eval
meta.description: Design or audit a model-agnostic evaluation harness for an LLM or multimodal LLM on a clinical task (radiology report generation, visual question answering, clinical text extraction/classification) — the adjudicated reference standard, clinical-efficacy metrics (RadGraph-F1 / CheXbert-F1 beyond BLEU/ROUGE), faithfulness and hallucination, pretraining-contamination of public benchmarks, prompt-sensitivity and determinism, answer-matching, and a reader study — and gate the plan for those axes. Works on a closed API or open weights. Never fabricates outputs or scores, and never reports n-gram overlap as clinical correctness.

copy.tagline: 设计临床 LLM 评估方案，确保模型可靠合规。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为医疗场景的 LLM 设计严谨的评估流程。
